objective: The meaningful result today is not ‘we generated a 3D picture.’ It is ‘we can turn reviewed prediction-derived geometry into identifiable IFC building elements, preserve uncertainty, and inspect the result.’ That is a concrete step toward the PM’s BIM goal—and it creates a stable destination for the ML improvements that follow.

model.description: SYNTHETIC exporter smoke test for bim_bridge_v0: one rectangular room, one diagonal partition and one hosted aperture on a raised storey. Not a real building and not a prediction.

scale.note: Synthetic geometry is authored directly in metres. There is no drawing, so there is no scale and no dimensional claim about any building.

ifc.schema_basis: Prototype choice. No receiving BIM application or accepted IFC schema is documented in the inspected repositories.

coordinate_system.origin: south-west centreline corner of the synthetic room

notes: SYNTHETIC: no source image, no prediction and no model were used.

result.note: A technical PASS means the file matches its input and passes schema and geometry checks. It is not a reviewed prediction bridge and not downstream acceptance.

counts.correction_time_note: No human correction took place, so no correction time was captured.
